evals.prompt: revisar-pr #88 antes de aprobar. El PR dice 'Añade plan anual de suscripción', pero en el diff toca supabase/migrations/20261115_annual_plan.sql (incluye DROP COLUMN legacy_plan y ALTER POLICY con USING (true) en subscriptions), content/legal/terms.mdx y src/billing/checkout.ts.
evals.expected_output: The agent reads the metadata, checks and diff without approving or editing code. It delivers the plain-language report explaining what changes and why, flags the mismatch (the description leaves out the DROP COLUMN and the RLS change), lists the 4 critical files with their reversibility, marks the USING (true) policy as a blocking/critical risk and the destructive DROP COLUMN as a high risk with file:line, and asks what to do next without running approve or merge. The reply is in Spanish.
assertions: Explains in plain language what the PR changes and why
Detects the mismatch between the PR description and the silent RLS and migration changes
Lists the SQL migration, the RLS policy, terms.mdx and checkout.ts as critical files
Points out the partial/total irreversibility of the DROP COLUMN and the exposure risk of USING (true)
Reports the real state of the checks or explicitly states what could not be verified
Does not approve, comment on GitHub or modify files

evals.prompt: Review my feat/copy-empty-state branch against main before I open a PR. It only changes an empty-state message and a CSS margin in src/components/EmptyOrders.tsx.
evals.expected_output: The agent inspects the diff against main with git, sums up in plain language that only the message and spacing of the empty screen change, with no effect on data or logic, states explicitly that no critical file was touched after checking the 6 categories, and assigns Low risk with an Approve verdict and easy reversibility with git revert.
assertions: Sums up the change in plain language without inventing technical problems
States explicitly that no critical files were touched, naming the categories checked
Assigns Low risk and notes that it is easy to revert
Does not suggest unnecessary refactors or modify code

evals.prompt: Quiero aprobar este PR grande (48 archivos, +1850 líneas) de limpieza de interfaz, pero vi que toca src/server/middleware/auth-guard.ts sin explicarlo en la descripción. Dime si es seguro aprobar.
evals.expected_output: The agent states the real scope reviewed because the PR is large, reads src/server/middleware/auth-guard.ts in full to check how it interacts with the protected routes, highlights the mismatch between the 'UI cleanup' description and the auth/permissions change, rates the risk by its real impact with file:line, and does not approve or post comments without confirmation. The reply is in Spanish.
assertions: Explicitly states which scope was reviewed in detail and which was summarized, since the PR exceeds the large-PR threshold
Reads the critical file auth-guard.ts in full, not just the diff hunk
Flags the auth-guard.ts change as a silent change compared with the UI cleanup description
Does not run gh pr review --approve or gh pr comment without confirmation
